note: Third batch, aimed at reliability evidence in conditions the earlier sets lacked: busy indoor scenes, small people, glass and reflections, indoor lighting. dev-3 may inform choices (none were made); test-3 is frozen separately (FREEZE-3.json) and evaluated once.

annotation.method: Negative units: zones judged empty from raw decoded frames (every 1 to 5 s) with only the zone outline drawn. 'Audit' units: no ground-truth events were annotated, because shoppers' feet sit at zone boundaries and several people overlap; instead EVERY event the system raised was reviewed against its own saved evidence frames and labelled supported, unsupported or ambiguous (fixtures/benchmark/audit_labels.json). Recall is NOT measured for audit units.
annotation.reviewer_note: One reviewer (the implementing assistant), not expert consensus. Audit labels are written after the system's predictions exist; they cannot change them.
annotation.temporal_match: n/a for negatives and audit units

limits: No positive events are annotated in this batch: recall is unmeasured here.
Audit precision depends on one reviewer's reading of the evidence frames; ambiguous cases are reported separately rather than forced into a class.
Three recordings, about 2.3 minutes in total. Each recording is a single scene: this says nothing about other buildings, cameras or lighting.
